Perfect for when someone is just asking to get fucked. Strike your enemy in the face and watch their pride crumble! And if you really want to add insult to emotional injury, put some extra strength into your dildoslap and watch ‘em get bow-legged.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot and rolling for damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of causing a Critical Injury. When this weapon causes a Critical Injury, the victim’s MOVE is reduced by 2 for 3 seconds (1 Round) in addition to the damage and other effects. Whenever this weapon causes a Critical Injury or deals damage via an Aimed Shot to a target’s head, the victim must beat a DV17 Concentration Check to not be morally damaged and suffer a -2 penalty to all Actions until the end of their next Turn.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
